snippet.title: Can Drone Pilots Refuse a Surrender?
snippet.description:
Do Drone Operators Have To Accept a Surrender?

Because although Ukraine has brought this issue front and centre, it’s actually not a new problem.

Back in 1991, the battleship the USS Wisconsin bombarded an enemy position.

The US then sent a reconnaissance drone to check out the damage when 40 soldiers suddenly left their cover and surrendered to the drone  making it the first time troops had surrendered to an unmanned vehicle.

But now, with the prevalence of fpv drones, we’ve seen countless soldiers surrendering to unmanned vehicles so do their operators have to accept the surrender?

snippet.title: OBC Creamy Layer Reservation पर Supreme Court ने क्यों ठुकराई सरकार की मांग, 100 OBC IAS का क्या?
snippet.description:
The Supreme Court has refused the Centre's request for two more years to implement its ruling on the OBC creamy layer. The dispute concerns the treatment of salaries earned by parents working in Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) and the private sector while determining their children's eligibility for OBC reservation. The Centre's 2004 order allowed such salaries to be counted, even though the 1993 Office Memorandum excluded salary and agricultural income from the calculation. The Supreme Court held that excluding candidates solely on the basis of their parents' salaries amounts to hostile discrimination. The controversy affected around 100 OBC candidates who cleared civil services examinations but were denied appointments. It also delayed service allocation for the 958 candidates who cleared the 2025 Civil Services Examination. The video explains the legal battle, the court's latest directions, and the wider implications. It also covers key Supreme Court updates on Delhi's air pollution, the Kerala Congress contempt case and Tarun Tejpal's bail plea.

snippet.title: Wenn der Patient mehr weiß als sein Therapeut – ein Autist packt aus!
snippet.description:
Für viele Menschen ist Psychotherapie ein wichtiger Schritt, um sich selbst besser zu verstehen, persönliche Herausforderungen zu bewältigen und Unterstützung zu finden.

Doch was passiert, wenn man sich ausgerechnet dort nicht verstanden fühlt, wo man eigentlich Hilfe sucht?

Joachim berichtet in unserer Mindseed-Kreisdiskussion zum Thema Autismus von seinen Erfahrungen mit zahlreichen Therapeut:innen. Immer wieder hatte er das Gefühl, dass sein Gegenüber seine Wahrnehmung und seine Bedürfnisse nicht wirklich nachvollziehen konnte. Besonders frustrierend war für ihn, dass er zunehmend das Gefühl bekam, selbst dafür verantwortlich zu sein, dass die Therapie funktioniert.

Seine Geschichte wirft eine wichtige Frage auf: Wie gut sind Therapeut:innen darauf vorbereitet, die unterschiedlichen Wahrnehmungsweisen und Bedürfnisse autistischer Menschen zu verstehen?

Denn gerade dort, wo Menschen Unterstützung suchen, sollten sie sich verstanden, ernst genommen und respektiert fühlen.

snippet.title: Hyatt Regency: 114 muertos en una fiesta
snippet.description:
El colapso del Hyatt Regency de Kansas City en 1981 mató a 114 personas en plena fiesta, cuando dos pasarelas cayeron sobre la pista de baile.
Descubre cómo un cambio de diseño aprobado por teléfono, sin cálculos, duplicó la carga de las vigas y condenó la estructura.

El 17 de julio de 1981, durante un té danzante con unas 1,600 personas en el atrio del hotel, la pasarela del cuarto piso se desplomó sobre la del segundo. En este video recorremos la historia de Pamela Coffey, una niña de 11 años, y el rescate de 14 horas entre escombros, agua y oscuridad. También explicamos el error de diseño de las varillas de acero, el papel de Havens Steel y de la firma de Jack Gillum, y qué pasó después con las licencias, las demandas y las reglas de la ingeniería.

snippet.title: समधी जी ने रखी कार की शर्त! 😱 जेठानी का ओवन जला, छोटी बहू ने बनाई असली दाल बाटी चूरमा?#shorts #drama
snippet.description:
Jab ameeri ke ghamand mein Jethani aur Nanad ne milkar Chhoti Bahu ke aansu nikale aur car jeetne ke chakkar mein modern oven mein batiyan jala di, tab Chhoti Bahu ne gas tandoor par banayi 100% authentic, step-by-step Rajasthani Daal Baati Churma! Jethani ne raste mein tel girakar saazish rachi, lekin cute puppy ne aakar uska plan kaise chopat kiya?

Lekin Scene 24 mein Samdhi Ji ne jo 50 Lakh ka check aur secret call recording play ki, usne pure khandaan ke hosh uda diye! Kya Jethani jayegi jail? Janne ke liye turant comment karein "PART-2"!

Easy Recipe Highlights (Step-by-Step):

• Baati Dough: 2 cup mota gehun ka aata + 1/2 cup sooji + ajwain + namak + 4 tbsp desi ghee moyan (mutthi binding test).

• Shaping & Baking: Lukewarm water stiff dough, thumb-dent technique & slow-baking on preheated gas tandoor till golden cracks appear.

• Panchmel Dal: Equal ratio of 5 dals boiled with haldi-salt, topped with sizzling ghee-hing-jeera-tomato tadka.

• Churma: Hot baatis crushed by hand, blended with boora/khand, cardamom & roasted dry fruits.

• Finishing: Hot baati cracked & soaked in pure melted desi ghee.

snippet.title: Trump is 'doubling down on craziness' by appointing Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff
snippet.description:
Donald Trump is replacing his top White House aide Susie Wiles after the Republicans took a hammering in the US midterms.

Trump biographer Michael Wolff joins Rachel Johnson to give his immediate reaction - and to explain why he's trying to raise so much money despite leaving office in two years.

The President said that his deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller will become his new chief of staff, with Ms Wiles moving over to his political operation.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump said Miller is "one of my most trusted advisors", as he praised Wiles for doing "an outstanding job".

Ms Wiles has taken to Twitter to confirm she is leaving her role.

She wrote: "Today is my last day as White House Chief of Staff.   Serving President Trump in the White House has been the honor of a lifetime. I’m so proud to have been a part of what we’ve accomplished together from securing our border and cutting taxes to strengthening our economy and putting America First.

"More than anything, I’m grateful for the extraordinary people I’ve had the privilege of working alongside. While my role may be changing, my commitment to the President and the mission never will."

In a post on Truth Social, Trump said Miller is "one of my most trusted advisors", as he praised Wiles for doing "an outstanding job".

Meanwhile, two top officials at the US Department of Justice resigned on Friday, accelerating an exodus of senior figures from the department following the midterm elections.

The departures of John Eisenberg, who headed the DOJ's National Security Division, and Jason Reding Quiñones, who pursued probes into past criminal investigations of Trump, follow the resignation of civil rights unit chief Harmeet Dhillon on Thursday.

Mr Trump’s party was stripped of control of the Senate and the House of Representatives this week following a string of historic losses in once Republican strongholds.

Mr Trump responded to the losses by saying it would have been a "landslide" if he had been on the ticket before taking aim at his party's candidates and blaming the war in Iran.
